g.text: A Practical Guide to Running a Local LLM
The first decision is which model family and parameter size to run. Model choice depends on your
hardware, your task, and how much setup time you're willing to spend. For general chat, summarization,
and light coding, a 7B–14B parameter model is the sweet spot on consumer hardware: models like Llama 3.1
8B, Mistral 7B, or Qwen 2.5 14B deliver strong quality while staying fast. If you have a 24–48 GB GPU or
a Mac with 64 GB+ unified memory, jump to 30B–70B models such as Llama 3.3 70B (quantized) or Mixtral
[Write a task to measure generation speed.]
